summary: New Heights Academy Charter School urges the FCC to keep E‑Rate funding strong and to simplify the application process so that small schools can participate more easily. The comment urges the FCC to preserve the core E‑Rate program, maintain a broad definition of educational purpose, and avoid changes that would reduce access, increase administrative burden, or limit local flexibility.
